claims.claim: Deferred primal forests exactly decide complete raw positive singleton cancellation over all primal forests for a fixed closed-walk occurrence matrix.
claims.scope: Authenticated source-core or supported finite boundary matrix; closed-walk restrictions required; fixed retained rows and dual choice.

claims.claim: A nonempty full-matrix stopping set obstructs complete raw cancellation for every primal forest.
claims.scope: Restricted raw model only; not a nonhandlebody or nonunknot certificate. Partial residual optimality concerns column peeling only.

claims.claim: Exceptional-interface dual selection takes at most Bell(u+1) polynomial matroid-intersection calls, hence 2^{O(u log(u+2))} poly(N) time.
claims.scope: Exact finite graph/matrix selector. No native extraction adapter in this package. Native u<=3k bound only for original source-core columns.

claims.claim: The finite dual selector agrees with an independent exhaustive tree/uncapped peeling oracle on 50658 inputs; all 5183 positive outputs replay.
claims.scope: Finite supplied instances, including disconnected input rejection and 4,000 seeded cases. No geometric realization assertion for random inputs.

claims.claim: The theta family has 3^h primal trees, exactly 2^h successful trees, canonical failure, and linear indexed deferred discovery. Its unsigned handle incidences admit a three-ball realization.
claims.scope: Geometric existence by an actual two-handle slide. No native triangulated-source exporter. Unpruned lexicographic trial count (3^h+1)/2 is not a lower bound for every algorithm.

claims.claim: Triangle-column parity and three occurrences do not alone imply abstract dual-tree invariance.
claims.scope: 9 vertices,25 edge rows,17 triangle columns; one successful tree and one tree with a nine-row stopping residual. No native realization.

claims.claim: Deferred peeling preserves the span of a binary represented matrix whose kernel contains the uncapped occurrence rows, allowing a column basis to be selected afterward.
claims.scope: Finite linear algebra; arbitrary column bases do not imply geometric collapsibility or marked transport.

claims.claim: Historical whole-cut coverage increases from 92/106 to 99/106; additional coverage from 10/14 to 12/14; all old positives retained.
claims.scope: Given fixed source corpora and baseline breadth-first dual reduction. All 213 paired positive outputs independently replayed. No knot-diagram success-rate inference.

claims.claim: Regina literal oracle agrees with 104 deferred positives among 113 completed sources; seven additional positives exceed the expansion cap.
claims.scope: 4096-normal-disc cap,20-second timeout; no timeout or mismatch observed. Native certificates for all 111 successes replayed. Remaining nine refusals are not native negative verdicts.

claims.claim: Core coverage increases from 110/120 to 118/120, including 106/106 historical cores.
claims.scope: Core recognition alone does not settle the reconstructed whole cut.

claims.claim: 1707 distinct real tests pass across the main test run and targeted environmental recovery.
claims.scope: Not a single clean full-suite invocation. Missing sparse-checkout dependencies and three recovery-harness cwd failures were corrected without production edits.

claims.claim: On 110 common-success native cores, deferred producer median batch time is 1.3889043482 times canonical.
claims.scope: 9 alternating repetitions,25 corpus passes,2750 calls per batch; source preparation and replay excluded. Deferred is slower here; no uniform wall-clock speedup is claimed.

claims.claim: Whole-cut group certificates can imply abstract handlebodies under connected orientable irreducible source and proper two-sided boundary-bearing cut assumptions.
claims.scope: Classical Loop-Theorem/free-group criterion. Not a new theorem of 3-manifold topology, not implemented coverage, no search/size bound or marked meridian transport.

claims.claim: A complete n^{O(log n)} unknot recognizer is not established by this work.
claims.scope: Missing complete hierarchy engine, global depth/repair/encoding/interface bounds, and bounded complete terminal strategy.
